sources.quote: A temporary deviation may cover at most 2000 pieces and at most 6 weeks.
Request a temporary deviation from STL to cover the Alluminio B delay: ship 3,500 BR-220 pieces over 10 weeks with 100% hole inspection.

findings.why: The request is for 3,500 pieces over 10 weeks. This exceeds both limits of PRC-DEV-007 rev 2, which are 2000 pieces and 6 weeks. The 100% hole inspection is required but does not change the limits.

sources.quote: 8.7.1.1 A temporary deviation is requested through the supplier portal and needs approval before shipment.

findings.why: BR-220 is shipped to STL (ASL-TO-2026-04 lists BR-220 at TO1 for STL). The STL customer requirement says a temporary deviation must be requested through the supplier portal and approved before shipment. No document in force shows an approval or a request for this deviation, so STL's written approval is needed before any shipment.
